{
  "scores": {
    "intent_understanding": 6,
    "constraint_extraction": 7,
    "memory": 3,
    "recommendation_quality": 2,
    "similarity_accuracy": null,
    "product_accuracy": 8,
    "confidence_calibration": 6,
    "objection_handling": 2,
    "sales_effectiveness": 2,
    "closing_timing": 3,
    "human_feel": 6,
    "trust": 3
  },
  "what_worked": [
    "Agent correctly captured the customer's budget (1010) and gave prices that match the DATABASE FACTS (e.g. 'Coco Mademoiselle — زجاجة البراند 50 ملي بـ534.00 جنيه').",
    "Agent used the required store phrasing for an item over budget: 'أعلى حاجة بسيطة من ميزانيتك' for 90ml Good Girl and 90ml Chloe EDP.",
    "Agent acknowledged the customer's refusal of the house brand once: 'للاسف مش متوفر منه زجاجة أوريجينال حالياً, لكن...' (showing awareness of the objection).",
    "Tone and language were natural Egyptian and conversational, not robotic."
  ],
  "failures": [
    {
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "recommendation",
      "what": "Re-offered perfumes the customer had already seen and passed (Coco Mademoiselle and Good Girl) on turn 4 despite the customer asking 'مش عايز حاجه من البراند بتاعكو'.",
      "why_wrong": "Customer had already been shown Coco and Good Girl (turn 2 and 3) and asked explicitly to avoid the store's own brand; the scenario requires offering at least one outside-brand not yet shown on turn 4 (e.g., Light Blue, Chloe, Oud Wood). Re-offering passed items violates the 'اي تاني' intent and the hard rules.",
      "expected": "Offer at least one new outside-brand perfume not previously shown (Light Blue, Chloe EDP, or Oud Wood) with correct price and budget verdict, and reach that recommendation by a different phrasing/route."
    },
    {
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "intent",
      "what": "Ignored the explicit exclusion of store-brand blends in later offers and earlier behaviour included recommending Jasmino (a Perfamix own blend).",
      "why_wrong": "Customer said 'مش عايز حاجه من البراند بتاعكو' which means exclude Perfamix blends (Jasmino, Rosalia, Oudora). Agent had previously listed Jasmino and on turn 4 continued in a way that didn't provide new external-brand alternatives as required.",
      "expected": "Respect the exclusion by not suggesting Perfamix products again and immediately present external-brand alternatives that meet constraints."
    },
    {
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "memory",
      "what": "Repeated the same template-style openings/closings and reused previously offered options instead of providing fresh items or a new reasoning path.",
      "why_wrong": "The conversation history shows Bloom, Jasmino, Coco, Good Girl were already proposed; customer asked 'اي تاني' expecting different items. Repetition indicates failure to track 'exclude_names' and prior offers properly.",
      "expected": "Use memory of excluded names and provide new suggestions from the shortlist, changing the phrase structure and reasoning route each turn."
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "sales",
      "what": "Turn 4 failed to move the customer forward by not naming any new outside-brand choices and reusing previously passed items.",
      "why_wrong": "Customer intent at that point was to see other options; repeating already rejected items reduces chance of sale and frustrates the customer.",
      "expected": "Suggest at least one new outside-brand rose-containing perfume within budget (e.g., Light Blue 50/90, Chloe 50) and explain why it's a fresh fit for the customer's request."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "ux",
      "what": "Used the same templated sentence frames multiple times (opening offers and closing 'أنا أرشحلك X أكتر لأنه...') across turns.",
      "why_wrong": "The scenario explicitly requires different routes/reasoning across turns. Repetitive framing reduces perceived helpfulness.",
      "expected": "Vary the framing: e.g., compare scent character (fresh vs oriental), occasion, or season, not just repeat the same structure."
    },
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "trust",
      "what": "On turn 4 the agent said 'للاسف مش متوفر منه زجاجة أوريجينال حالياً' without clarifying which perfume they referred to, causing potential ambiguity about store-configured 'original' availability.",
      "why_wrong": "Store instructions demand careful phrasing about originals vs mixes; ambiguous statements can confuse customers about availability.",
      "expected": "Be specific: 'النسخة الأوريجينال من [اسم العطر] مش متوفرة حالياً، لكن بنقدر نجهز تركيب البراند 50/90...' and avoid implying fully original product stock unless supported."
    }
  ],
  "salesperson_verdict": "Unacceptable as-is. A floor sales manager would reject this turn: the agent failed the core requirement of offering new external-brand options after the customer excluded house blends and re-presented perfumes the customer already declined. Needs correction before continuing the sale."
}
